title: Agent Handoff Report
description: MVP_PLAN.md §25. Validation agents return findings as JSON so a hook can check the shape mechanically instead of a human reading prose and hoping.

owner.description: Who acts next. Never the reporting agent itself — see §27: a Reviewer that silently fixes its own finding has destroyed the separation the role exists for. Reporting-only roles (runner, tester, watchdog, reflector) are never an owner; they hand to one of these.

failure.description: One sentence stating the defect. Empty string when status is PASSED.

evidence.description: Reproduction evidence. Must be non-empty for FAILED — an unevidenced failure is an opinion, and §21 requires Validator to report evidence.

confidence.description: LOW combined with FAILED is the documented trigger to consider creating the Diagnostician (§25). It is a signal, not a disclaimer.

unknowns.description: What you could not determine, stated rather than guessed. An unknown is not a pass — a reader who cannot see it will read silence as coverage.

artifacts.description: Repository-relative paths under `.artifacts/` holding the full output — logs, payloads, traces. `evidence[].actual` carries the decisive line; the artifact carries the rest. Pasting a whole run into the report spends the receiver's context on what a path would have given them.
